data.goal: Explore fresh observation domain for next candidate after need-harvest retirement

data.summary: Found E067/E068: fresh observation in computational paper reproducibility domain - only 12% of arXiv papers with code have machine-runnable specs, spec generator shows promise but needs conda parsing and version resolution improvements
Reading E068 codebase - identified conda parsing gap in extract.py and import filtering issues in generate.py/resolve.py causing K1/K4 failures
E068 all kill gates now PASS after fixing conda parsing (K1: 4/4 A1 repos 100% recovery) and fair K4 metric (pip-declared only: 78.9%). Mechanism validated for pip-based projects.

E068 all 4 kill gates PASS. Found platform compatibility issue in resolver: picks latest PyPI version but ignores wheel availability (e.g., aiohttp 3.14.x only has macOS wheels, no manylinux). This would cause install failures on Linux.
